The chunk's load-bearing claims all independently reproduce: 618/618 R100 byte-preserving renames, constants correct per §2.2 with the independence contract intact, both judges behaving exactly as designed (3/3 skip / 3/3 pass, hashes matching locks), suite at 197 passed + 3 skipped on Python 3.9.6, and all six builder findings are technically sound — including the .gitignore refusal, whose premise I confirmed false and whose gitignore-semantics claim is accurate.
